definitions.explanation: Formal questioning or inquiry, especially in official proceedings such as parliamentary sessions, meetings, or academic presentations.

examples.japanese: {質疑|しつぎ}⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧です。
examples.english: It's time for the Q&A session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{質疑|しつぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Questioning was conducted regarding the budget proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{質疑|しつぎ}⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: A Q&A session is scheduled after the presentation, so if you have questions, please ask then.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (question) + {疑|ぎ} (doubt, inquiry). A formal word used primarily in official or institutional contexts.

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the compound {質疑|しつぎ}⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧ (Q&A, question and answer). Used in parliamentary proceedings (⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧), business meetings, academic conferences, and other formal settings. More formal than ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ (question).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {質疑|しつぎ}⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧ — question and answer session, Q&A
- {質疑|しつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — to conduct questioning
- {質疑|しつぎ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ — questioning period
- {質疑|しつぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧ — to respond to questions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ — question (general, everyday use)
- {尋問|じんもん} — interrogation (legal/police context, more confrontational)
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧ — deliberation (broader process of examining and discussing a matter)
